description: This PHP file defines a class 'Review' within the OpenCart admin controller namespace, managing review-related tasks such as generating review task lists, listing reviews as JSON files, and clearing review JSON files. It interacts with models for stores, languages, products, reviews, and tasks, and performs file operations for exporting and clearing review data.

classes.name: Review
classes.description: Controller class providing functionalities for generating, listing, and clearing review data in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates a list of review-related tasks for each store and language, scheduling tasks with the task model.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Generates a JSON file of reviews for a specific store and language, handling directory creation and file writing.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Deletes existing review JSON files for all stores and languages.
